# Sofia Varelli – Complete Site Documentation

## About
Sofia Varelli is a real‑life creator. This platform offers exclusive adult content (photos, videos, direct messages) via paid subscription. No AI‑generated content. Only the creator uploads. All models are 18+ with documented consent.

## Page Index

### Home
- URL: https://sofiavarelli.com/
- Purpose: Landing page introducing Sofia, showing free preview photos, and presenting subscription plans.

### Gallery
- URL: https://sofiavarelli.com/gallery
- Purpose: Browse all exclusive photos by category (Lingerie, Bikini, Behind the Scenes, Personal, Favorites). Locked photos require subscription or PPV.

### Videos
- URL: https://sofiavarelli.com/videos
- Purpose: Watch exclusive videos (Solo, Bikini, Behind the Scenes, Custom). Locked videos require subscription or PPV.

### Messages
- URL: https://sofiavarelli.com/messages
- Purpose: Direct private messaging with Sofia. Subscribers can send messages; Sofia may reply with locked media.

### Bundles
- URL: https://sofiavarelli.com/bundles
- Purpose: Purchase discounted content packs (bundles) that include multiple photos/videos permanently.
